items.text: Items bought from livestock vendors now correctly belong to the purchasing player.
Livestock selling now uses a server‑side RPC instead of client‑side triggers, fixing desync issues.
Fixed incorrect UI text shown when a player drops wool during a conversation.
Teammates can no longer use the break‑in option on a teammate's own apartment room.
Fixed a bug where teammates were unable to exit rooms after a server restart.
Critters now transition from a startled state to fleeing when they take damage while startled.
Radtown loot crate moved farther from the window to prevent cheating.
Trainyard powergrid loot crate repositioned and windows/railings blocked to stop exploitative shooting.
Gaps that allowed shooting into Harbor 1 loot room have been boarded up.
All windows that let players look into or shoot into Harbor 2 loot room have been sealed.
Fixed a null‑reference crash caused by destroyed elevator floors during save operations.
Resolved mortar desynchronization when players reconnect or enter network range.
Nailgun third‑person model updated: removed SprintController, added aiming bool and new aim clips for smoother handling.
Livestock now match player speed when being led, preventing lead breaks and long waits
Floating animals bug fixed and idle performance improved
Critter health reduced (frogs to 60 HP, rabbits to 100 HP) for better balance
Frog size increased by 20%
Frog first jump length fixed and dead‑animation pool bug resolved
Crabs and jellyfish receive step‑height fix, obstacle‑avoidance raycasts, corrected leg speeds and optimized water checks
Bull AI look‑rotation vector issue fixed when target is lost
Open fence gates added to the ranch and large barn, improving access to the vendor area
Water source (sink) transfer between rooms is now correctly blocked, preventing unintended item moves

Fixed duplicate Custom SMG entry and replaced it with a Thompson; filtered vendor items by game mode to prevent guns in Primitive; corrected turret offering to appear only on high‑quality sales; added new high‑end sale options (basic BP fragments, Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, HC Revolver); updated wool sales to constitute ~75% of livestock sales with no guns.
Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
Corrected crossbow arrow head rotation for bowless crossbows, ensuring arrows fly in the intended direction.
Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.
Fixed bug that let water sources be transferred between rooms (sinks).
Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn for easier access to the vendor.
Livestock now matches player speed when being led, reducing lead breaks.
Frogs are now 20% larger, have reduced health to 60, and feature a corrected first jump, making them easier to encounter.
Crabs received step‑height, obstacle‑avoidance, and leg‑speed improvements; jellyfish swarms added and water checks batched for better performance.
Bull AI rotation fixed when losing target, per‑frame animation allocation reduced, and floating animal idle performance improved.

Livestock vendor inventory updated: duplicate Custom SMG replaced with Thompson, items filtered by game mode, low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and weapons, and wool now makes up ~75% of sales.
Biofuel generator is now completely silent while idle, removing its background hum.

2026-09-28.summary:
### Combat
- Fixed mortar desync when reconnecting or entering network range, preventing weapon synchronization issues.
- Corrected crossbow arrow head rotation for bowless crossbows, ensuring arrows fly in the intended direction.

### Map & Loot Rooms
- Closed gaps and windows that allowed shooting into the Harbor 1 and Harbor 2 loot rooms.

### Base Building
- Fixed bug that let water sources be transferred between rooms (sinks).
- Added open fence gates to the ranch and large barn for easier access to the vendor.

### Animals & Wildlife
- Livestock now matches player speed when being led, reducing lead breaks.
- Frogs are now 20% larger, have reduced health to 60, and feature a corrected first jump, making them easier to encounter.
- Crabs received step‑height, obstacle‑avoidance, and leg‑speed improvements; jellyfish swarms added and water checks batched for better performance.
- Bull AI rotation fixed when losing target, per‑frame animation allocation reduced, and floating animal idle performance improved.

### Economy & Vendors
- Livestock vendor inventory updated: duplicate Custom SMG replaced with Thompson, items filtered by game mode, low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include BP fragments and weapons, and wool now makes up ~75% of sales.

### Audio
- Biofuel generator is now completely silent while idle, removing its background hum.

items.text: Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.
Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.
Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-27.summary:
### Livestock & Animals
- Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
- Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
- Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
- Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.

### Structures
- Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-26.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
